text:
Tye Kartye was a fourth-liner in Seattle, undrafted, a free-agent find who worked his way up through the AHL. In New York he is playing 16 minutes a night, up from under 12, with 13 points in 19 games after 0.34 a game last season. He scored against the Kraken on Saturday, which made for a good weekend.

The breakout is real in the ways that matter. His own chances have more than doubled, from 0.46 expected goals per 60 to 0.99, and the Rangers take 56% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) with him on the ice. He also has 52 hits, so the game he made his name with hasn't gone anywhere.

Some scoring will cool. He is shooting 18.2% against a range near 14%. And 19 games is a small sample; ice time settles faster than scoring does. Our projection is about 52 points, which would still be more than double his best season. The Rangers seem to have found a middle-six forward on a bargain, and he seems to know it.
headline: Kartye has found a bigger job in New York
